milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The birch_button is at spawn-relative (-3, 2, 2) on the north wall of room 1, mounted on a prominent 3x2 birch_planks patch. max_distance=5 ensures the player must be in room 1 near the north wall (not accidentally triggering from room 2 which is 9+ blocks away). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the button/planks area.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The smithing_table is at spawn-relative (4, 0, 11) in room 2, past the doorway at z=8. max_distance=8 requires the player to have navigated through or near the doorway into room 2's area (the table is 7 blocks from the doorway center, so the player must be past the dividing wall or at the doorway looking through). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the smithing_table.
